ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Federal Power to Target Individuals and Organizations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of federal power to target individuals and organizations, and the potential for abuse of authority.
questions: What is the extent of the DOJ's involvement in the investigation?
What are the implications for free speech and assembly?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and abuse of power, and could have major implications for the balance of power between the government and individuals.
